title: Foldable thinking, tool, and result rows
objective: Make thinking, tool use, tool result, approvals, and result-card rows compact by default with explicit expand/collapse and inspector handoff behavior.
actions: Define compact and expanded render states for thinking, tool use, tool result, approval, and result-card messages.
Default noisy runtime details to compact one-line rows and route full details to the inspector.
Persist expanded state by stable message id so virtualization does not reset user selection.
Ensure expanded row height is measured and reflected in virtual scroll offsets.
Expose clear keyboard actions for expand/collapse and open inspector.

criteria: Tool and result rows are readable in compact mode without hiding failure or approval state.
Expanding a row reveals full details and updates virtualized height safely.
Inspector handoff works for latest result and selected message/action rows.
Tests cover compact/expanded rendering, result-card detail availability, and approval rows.
Default conversation view remains conversation-first rather than dashboard-first.

non_goals: Do not change runtime result-card schemas unless required for display stability.
Do not make every tool output visible by default.
Do not remove existing detail surfaces.
findings: Foldable thinking, tool use, tool result, approval, and progress transcript rows are compact by default and expand via stable message fold keys.
Added message cursor state with previous/next/toggle/open behavior and inspector handoff for selected transcript messages.
Virtual conversation render cache now separates compact and expanded fold entries while keeping selection/search highlighting dynamic.
